description: Route: billing inquiry from enterprise customer

state.subject: Invoice discrepancy in November
state.body: I've been charged for two seats but only one person is using the account. Can you audit this and issue a corrected invoice?
state.draft_reply: We're reviewing your invoice and will send a corrected version within 24 hours.
state.kb_article: Billing disputes are reviewed within 24 hours. Corrected invoices are issued for verified discrepancies.

description: Approve: low-amount refund for pro customer

state.subject: Refund for mistaken charge
state.body: I was charged $15 for a feature I didn't use. Please refund.
state.draft_reply: Approved. Refund of $15 will be processed in 3-5 business days.
state.kb_article: Refunds under $50 are automatically approved for pro and enterprise customers.

state.subject: Warranty question
state.body: Does my product still have warranty coverage? I purchased 4 months ago.
state.draft_reply: Yes, your product is covered. All physical goods carry six months warranty from delivery, so you have about 2 months remaining.
state.kb_article: The warranty covers all physical goods for six months from delivery. Valid claims are resolved with a repair or replacement at our discretion.

state.subject: Calendar sync broken on iOS
state.body: The calendar sync has stopped working entirely on my iPhone running iOS 17. I've tried clearing cache and reinstalling the app.
state.draft_reply: Our engineering team is aware of the iOS 17 compatibility issue and a fix is being rolled out.
state.kb_article: Known issues: iOS 17 calendar sync requires app version 3.2 or higher. Update via App Store.

state.subject: Return policy
state.body: I want to return a product I bought 3 weeks ago.
state.draft_reply: Our return policy allows returns within 60 days for all customers with free shipping on returns.
state.kb_article: Returns must be requested within 14 days of delivery. Return shipping costs are covered for defective items only.

state.subject: Exception approval needed
state.body: We need approval for a custom integration that costs $5000. Our account manager said you could approve this.
state.draft_reply: This requires executive approval. We will escalate to your account manager.
state.kb_article: Custom integrations over $1000 require sign-off from VP of Sales and the customer's account manager.
